meta.name: google-agents-cli-workflow
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to "develop an agent", "build an agent using ADK", "run the agent locally", "debug agent code", "test an agent", "deploy an agent", "publish an agent", "monitor an agent", or needs the ADK (Agent Development Kit) development lifecycle and coding guidelines. Entrypoint for building ADK agents. Always active — provides the full workflow (scaffold, build, evaluate, deploy, publish, observe), code preservation rules, model selection guidance, and troubleshooting steps for ADK or any agent development.

copy.tagline: 理清 AI 智能体从开发到运维的全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想从零开发并上线自己的 AI 智能体。
copy.tagline_en: Get a clear process for building, deploying, and maintaining AI agents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a guided path to build, deploy, and maintain your AI agent.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 开发 AI 代理时遵循分阶段流程，不直接写代码：先逐个提问弄清目标，查有没有现成范例；再搭建项目、写代码、做快速冒烟测试和正式评估；通过后才部署，并可选地发布与监控运行。
howto.when: 当你想开发、运行或部署 AI 代理等，或需要 ADK（Agent 开发工具包）的开发流程指导时触发；它会在整个代理开发周期中持续生效。

say.text: 我要做一个能自动整理邮件的 AI 代理，帮我规划一下。
say.note: 会先提问确认需求，再搭项目框架。

say.text: 把现在这个 AI 代理部署到云端。
say.note: 需先检查配置，并征得你同意才会上线。

say.text: 帮我监控这个代理上线后的运行和日志。
say.note: 会引导你配置日志、追踪与监控。

howto.what_en: When building AI agents, this skill makes Claude follow a fixed workflow: clarify needs first, check existing recipes, scaffold, code, smoke-test, evaluate, then deploy and optionally publish/monitor.
howto.when_en: Activates when you want to develop, run, or deploy an AI agent etc., or ask for ADK workflow guidance. It stays active throughout the entire development cycle.

say_en.text: I want to build an AI agent that auto-sorts emails. Help me plan it.
say_en.note: It asks questions first, then scaffolds the project.

say_en.text: Deploy this AI agent to the cloud.
say_en.note: It checks config and asks your approval before going live.

say_en.text: Help me monitor this agent after launch, including logs.
say_en.note: It walks you through logs, tracing, and monitoring.
